title: Autonomous Scientific Experimentation Powered by Generative AI

contributions.purpose: 提出生成式AI驱动的自主科研闭环框架
contributions.mechanism: 把 LLM+GAN+RL+贝叶斯优化+机器人执行整合为假设生成→实验设计→执行→分析→反馈的闭环,强调假设驱动而非仅参数优化
contributions.evaluation: 定性:仅概念架构图(Figure 1),无系统实现
contributions.source_quote: the proposed approach uniquely integrates large language models (LLMs), generative adversarial networks (GANs), and simulation-based models in a closed research loop.

contributions.purpose: 用公共卫生案例做概念验证
contributions.mechanism: LLM 生成"疫苗覆盖率↑→流感住院率↓"假设,对模拟数据集拟合线性回归
contributions.evaluation: r=-0.81(强负相关),MSE=0.12;但数据为自造合成数据
contributions.source_quote: The results suggest that the LLM's hypothesis is plausible under simulated epidemiological data.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We distinguish our approach from existing automated experimentation platforms by emphasizing hypothesis-driven exploration rather than parameter optimization alone.

notes: reject。数据红旗(循环自证):所谓"validation"用的是作者自己按"historical surveillance trends"生成的合成数据集,数据本就按预期关系造出,r=-0.81 是自造数据自证,无独立经验数据——典型 circular self-validation。非实证适配问题:框架部分纯概念图无实现,evaluation 只能定性;案例部分虽有数字但不可信。trade-off:作者在 Challenges 章自认 interpretability、data-bias、false discoveries 风险。checklist AI 披露:各项均 B(mostly human assisted by AI);checklist Q7 statistical significance 自答 No(概念案例无误差条)。贡献由 abstract+conclusion 归纳两条。
